name: stripecard

frames.best_why: Hover state is complete: blue gradient, lifted photo and visible Learn link, cursor off the card.

tagline: Dark promo card with a cliff photo that lifts and tints blue on hover.
summary: A compact dark card pairing a coastal photo with a blue logo block, heading, short body copy and a Learn link that slides in when the card is hovered.
appearance: A dark charcoal card, portrait shaped, holding a photo of pale sea cliffs across its upper two-thirds. Below sit a small blue rounded square, a bold white heading, two lines of grey body text and a blue 'Learn about Atlas' link with a chevron.
behaviour: On hover the photo rises and scales, a blue gradient washes over its left side, and the Learn link fades up into view; the image area shrinks slightly to make room. Everything eases back to the resting state when the pointer leaves.
demo_content: Heading 'Incorporate your company', copy about forming a legal entity, link 'Learn about Atlas'.
search_phrases: feature card reveals link on hover
card with image that lifts on hover
use_when: A SaaS or fintech page needs a compact card that teases a service and reveals a call to action on hover.
avoid_when: Touch screens: the Learn link only appears on hover, so keyboard and mobile users may never see it.
customise: All copy, the image path and the blue palette are written inside the component; changing them means editing the file. No props are exposed.
weight_why: One image and a handful of CSS transitions; no JavaScript animation loop.

a11y.note: The Learn link only appears on hover, so it stays invisible when focused by keyboard, and the alt text 'shoes' does not match the cliff photo.

issues: The alt text says 'shoes' but the photo shows sea cliffs.
The Learn link is hidden until hover, so keyboard users cannot see it.
polish_why: Smooth hover reveal and tidy type; the hidden CTA and mismatched alt text are real flaws.
